# SkyrimNet_Leash

> SkyrimNet ↔ Leash Framework bridge for Skyrim SE. YAML actions + C++ eligibility decorators + Papyrus execute + bio prompt.

## Read by job

| Job | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Player / install / build | README.md |
| Agent policy | AGENTS.md |
| Action YAML | SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/config/actions/ |
| Prompts | SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/prompts/submodules/character_bio/0409_leashframework.prompt |
| SKSE / CMake | SKSE_Source/ |
| ESP | Spriggit/SkyrimNet_Leash/ |
| User leftovers | ToDo.md |

## Do not ingest (unless debugging that area)

- SKSE_Source/build/
- z-plan.md
- OStimNet/
- crash-*.log, Papyrus.0.log
- submodule internals except `Skyrim-Leash-Framework/papyrus/source/LeashFramework.psc`

## Compile reminders

- Papyrus: Cursor task `compile: pyro` only
- SKSE: CMake tasks under SKSE_Source (`debug` / `build-debug`)
